Great speaking earlier. We are excited to move forward and have attached the formal offer packet for the Senior ML Engineer role. The high-level summary:

- Base: $180,000 / year
- Bonus: 10% annual target
- Equity: 0.18% RSU grant (4-year vest, 1-year cliff)
- Relocation stipend: $7,500 (if needed)

Proposed start window: November 16–30, 2026. If you need a later date, please say so and we can propose an alternate onboarding slot.

Next steps I recommend:

2) If comfortable, sign the DocuSign envelope once we finalize language (I’ve attached the current PDF and a .docx for any redlines).

Attached: redwood_offer_SofiaRamos_v1.pdf, Sofia_Redlines_20261012.docx, onboarding_timeline_q4_2026.xlsx

If anything in the packet looks off, reply with comments or mark up the docx and cc me. Vivek, Laura — looping you for awareness and to confirm the proposed start window works on your side. Marcus, please flag if comp needs adjustments.

Thanks,
